title: Tower defense game

currentObservations.conceptLabel: Debugging web applications through systematic isolation
Pricing based on utility and strategic impact

transcript.content: ok the towers arent shooting again. the enemies just walk past them
Let's track it down. What's the first thing you'd check to figure out why a tower isn't shooting?
um maybe the range? like the enemy has to be close enough. let me check the range number... its 0. oops. i set it to 0 earlier when i was testing
Nice catch — you found it by checking the value yourself. Want to set it back?
yeah 80 like before. ok now they shoot. also can i make the freeze tower cost more coins since it's really strong, like 50 instead of 30
You can. Why do you think the freeze tower should cost more than the others?
cause it stops a whole group at once so its worth more. the basic tower only hits one so its cheaper
That's solid reasoning — pricing by how much value a unit gives. Let me update it to 50.
